unresolvedPrerequisites: Written non-display/recorded algorithmic-use rights for each source; TradingView display access is insufficient evidence
Actual daily vintage and next-release schedule receipts for DGS2/DGS10
Known complete event schedule plus monitored past-only material-news coverage; official RSS alone is partial
Actual DXY and dated GC trade/aggressor/continuity files with lawful exports; no inferred Footprint side labels
Verified spot BID/ASK and full commissions/fees/funding/FX/latency model before account-PnL claims
Separate explicit approval and declared request budget for any future data capture
New prospective data after version freeze; existing September/October archives are development evidence only

protocol.duration: 30 prospectively selected market sessions, maximum 90 calendar days; count all outages
protocol.noReuse: Exclude all observations before earliestCaptureUTC, even if downloaded later. September/October 2026 development archives are never holdout.
stages: Rights/schema/clock validation using private local exports
Observation-only capture after separate approval; validate real first-receipt timestamps
Frozen paper evaluation only after all prerequisites and data-quality criteria pass
stops: Any unresolved provenance, timing, duplicate/conflicting data or source outage blocks entries
Stop study for ledger/accounting discrepancy; preserve input and event hashes
Keep every adverse fill, rejected entry and stopped session in results; never tune on holdout
costs: Actual contemporaneous ASK-BID spread, never less than predeclared conservative floor
Adverse entry and exit slippage, latency/gap stress and partial/missed-fill assumptions
Round-trip broker commission plus exchange, clearing and regulatory charges if applicable
Overnight financing/rollover and FX conversion; if unknown, account performance remains blocked
Data-access costs separately from trade net PnL; no trial or purchase is authorized
protocol.hypotheses: No directional profitability claim; compare frozen V2 and full Ultimate with identical quote/cost/account assumptions.
endpoints: Joint and per-layer coverage, arrival latency/skew, explicit missingness
Net expectancy in R and currency, drawdown, exposure, open liabilities, rejected/gap fills
Dependence-aware confidence intervals and regime diagnostics; report insufficient sample without reoptimization
protocol.inferenceRule: A small sample or zero Ultimate trades is inconclusive. No readiness claim from engineering tests or IID intervals alone.
protocol.dailyContext: Mandatory known daily vintages, expire at documented next release or 7-day hard age cap, excluded from intraday directional vote and 60-second cross-market skew
protocol.calendar: Known schedule -30/+30 minutes; snapshot review deadline at most 24 hours
protocol.news: Observed past 30 minutes only; monitored coverage watermark at most 60 seconds behind decision; no future completeness claim
protocol.intraday: DXY/GC/true exchange-aggressor flow remain mandatory and fresh within 300 seconds, max 60-second observed skew, same GC contract
